sections.content: An image can be a source reference.

sections.name: context
sections.content: Answer to: should an image the writer uploads also become a source in references? The question recommended yes, always. Read by the agent as 'allowed, not automatic'; the owner has not confirmed that reading. Follows vignettes cc80d922 and 7358e231 (semanticops.com#71).
